english.title: Intent to mislead / defraud person with a copy of the rules of a registered society

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: cooperative and community benefit societies act 2014

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) with intent to mislead or defraud, gave to **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE PERSON..), a copy of rules other than the registered rules of a registered society, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE REGISTERED SOCIETY..), on the pretence that

(A)_[they were the society's existing rules]_
(B)_[there were no other rules of the society]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 19(1)(a) of the Co-operative and Community Benefit Societies Act 2014.
